data.content_ref: inline:The problem demands a runnable Python entry point solve(rule, width) returning {"all_short_cycles": bool, "witness": [...]}, and requires filing typed sandboxed Python simulations that RETURN per-(rule,width) transient and cycle-length tables. SRC_001 provides zero simulation_refs, zero definitions, and no code artifact; it offers only a prose claim and counterconditions. A reasoning envelope with no filed simulation content fails the explicit artifact requirement of the problem, independent of whether its bounds are numerically correct.
